_comment: Bolna agent config for Kural. The tool uses Bolna's custom_task format and calls the live brain's FLAT endpoint /file with templated %(name)s params. Set this up in Bolna Agent Studio (see docs/architecture/04-bolna-wiring.md). Verify exact field names against docs.bolna.ai before importing.

llm._note: any function-calling LLM works (Gemini / Groq / GPT)

tools.name: file_grievance
tools.description: Call this AFTER the caller confirms their complaint. Files the civic grievance and returns a ticket number + the owning government body. Use for any civic problem: water, power/electricity, garbage, road/pothole, streetlight, drainage, sewage, stray animals, etc.

sector.description: one of: electricity, water_supply, sewerage, roads_internal, roads_highway, stormwater, streetlight, solid_waste, sanitation_toilet, public_health, stray_animals, town_planning, property_tax, other

locality.description: the area / street / landmark the caller mentioned
